name: oh-my-hexflow
description: Injects the project decisions and work items from hexlog into the Claude Code session and guards the work item flow through hooks and the omhl CLI.

language.title: Conversation language
language.description: Language for the text the oh-my-hexflow agents address to you and, in a project with .omhl.toml, for the main session. Overrides the language setting of Claude Code. Leave empty to follow it.
